title: Hostile, closed environment
text: The cabin is a closed loop: air, water and microbes are recycled, and trace contaminants, dust and noise accumulate.
Life-support alarms outrank every app reading; on any atmosphere alarm, follow the emergency procedures, not this screen.
Log headaches, irritation or breathing changes promptly so patterns show in the history.

citations.source: NASA Human Research Program: the five hazards of human spaceflight — hostile, closed environment.
